text.description_html:
4-1/2" x 4" x Square Corner Commercial Brushed Stainless Steel Hinge with Square Corners

Heavy duty solid stainless steel commercial grade door hinge with 2 ball bearings, Square Corners and Non-Removable Pin (NRP). Typical used on 1-3/4" thick out-swing exterior doors.

Security Non-Removable Pin for exterior outswing doors, prevents the hinge pins removal by vandals and thieves. For additional protection we offer Exit Door Security Bars which prevent an exit door removal, even if the hinges are cut by burglars!

Features of the Stainless Steel Hinge for Commercial Doors:

  • Non-Removable Pin for Security
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Stainless Steel Hinge Pin
  • Conforms to ANSI A5112 for Stainless Steel Bearing Hinge

Specifications for Global CS4540BBNRP-US32D Stainless Steel Ball Bearing Hinge:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • Ball Bearings: 2 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: US32D Brushed Stainless Steel

Package with Stainless Steel machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

Sold Individually
